name: comp-360
title: Directional Pan Tooltips
description: A small cluster of four outlined arrow buttons around a centre dot, laid out like a directional pad. Hovering any arrow opens a tooltip naming the pan direction and its keyboard shortcut.
use: Icon-only navigation buttons need discoverable labels and shortcut hints on hover.
avoid: Tooltips only appear on hover or focus, so touch users get no explanation of the arrows.
a11y: Each arrow has an aria-label and focus opens its tooltip, but the printed key hints are not announced as actual shortcuts. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Five tiny round-cornered outlined squares on a near-black page: one up arrow on top, left and right arrows on either side of a small outlined circle, and a down arrow at the bottom. A light tooltip with a dark key badge appears beside the hovered arrow.
behaves: Hovering an arrow fades in a tooltip next to it with a direction label and a shortcut such as Cmd T; moving away fades it out again. The arrows are plain buttons.
customise: Button icons, aria labels, tooltip text and shortcut keys are written inline, so changes require editing the source; each tooltip's side is set per button.
weight: light: Four small buttons and a tooltip; nothing animates until hover.
